properties.name: Gaurikund to Kedarnath Alpine Trail
properties.access_restrictions: Motor vehicles strictly prohibited. Foot and mule traffic only. Registration checkpost at Sonprayag/Gaurikund.

properties.name: Govindghat to Valley of Flowers National Park
properties.access_restrictions: UNESCO World Heritage site. Forest permit required at Ghangaria checkpost. Overnight camping strictly forbidden in Valley.

properties.name: Ghangaria to Hemkund Sahib Alpine Lake
properties.access_restrictions: High-altitude holy lake. Severe oxygen depletion. Descend before 2 PM due to freezing cloud cover.

properties.name: Gangotri to Gaumukh & Tapovan Glacier Trek
properties.access_restrictions: Gangotri National Park permit required. Restricted to 150 trekkers per day. Guide compulsory beyond Bhojbasa.

properties.name: Sankri to Har Ki Dun Alpine Valley
properties.access_restrictions: Govind Pashu Vihar National Park checkpost at Netwar. Permit required.

properties.name: Chopta to Tungnath & Chandrashila Peak
properties.access_restrictions: Kedarnath Wildlife Sanctuary. No littering. Highest Shiva temple in the world (3,680m).

properties.name: Auli to Kuari Pass Curzon Trail
properties.access_restrictions: Nanda Devi Biosphere buffer zone permit required.

properties.name: Ransi to Madhyamaheshwar Temple
properties.access_restrictions: Panch Kedar holy trail. Crosses Markanga Ganga and Madhyamaheshwar Ganga bridges.

properties.name: Sagar to Rudranath Alpine Meadow Trail
properties.access_restrictions: Kedarnath Sanctuary boundary. High-altitude meadows subject to rapid fog inundation.

properties.name: Lohajung to Roopkund Mystery Lake
properties.access_restrictions: High-altitude ecological zone. Camping only in designated forest areas.

properties.name: Pantwari to Nag Tibba Summit
properties.access_restrictions: Tehri Garhwal forest division. Open year round.

properties.name: Sari to Deoriatal & Rohini Bugyal Ridge
properties.access_restrictions: Kedarnath Sanctuary eco-tourism permit at Sari entrance.
